verdict.rationale: Railway's docs explicitly offer "one-click deployable applications and starters for common use cases" [railway-docs-17]. The MCP server can also deploy templates [railway-docs-20], which confirms templates are a first-class deployable object. The evidence is only a one-line doc summary, so the depth of the catalog and the deploy flow are not shown. Missing for 10: detail on template catalog breadth and the one-click deploy flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
